response.sql: SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS average_ratio, COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count FROM fees WHERE feerate >= 0.0009;

alternatives.interpretation: Count only qualifying fee records with a nonmissing rebate rate, as well as excluding them from the average.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) AS average_ratio, COUNT(*) AS fee_record_count FROM fees WHERE feerate >= 0.0009 AND rebrate IS NOT NULL;
